meta.name: Hometown Giants
meta.description: Step inside the Vancouver Giants major junior hockey team, where celebrity owners Michael Bublé and Drew Scott set out to revive a franchise that hasn't won a championship since 2007. For the players, they're teenagers living away from home, finishing high school, and chasing NHL dreams they've built their lives around, even though only a few will ever make it.

videos.title: Championship or Bust
videos.overview: Celebrity owners Michael Bublé and Drew Scott are on a mission to bring the WHL's Vancouver Giants back to the top. After nearly 20 years without a championship, the pressure starts at Training Camp, where teenagers battle for roster spots. They're elite hockey players, but they're still kids, leaving home, growing up fast, and fighting to prove they belong.

videos.title: Do Your Job
videos.overview: With a new head coach, Parker Burgess, and a new GM, Hnat Domenichelli, expectations are high for the Giants. The roster is set, and it's time for the players to deliver. 17-year-old Ryan Lin is already under the spotlight as a projected first-round NHL draft pick, while 19-year-old Leonardo Domenichelli fights to earn his place on the team and prove he's more than the GM's son.

videos.title: Belonging
videos.overview: Every player is fighting for something. The Giants' seven rookies face the steep climb into major junior hockey, while veterans battle to protect their roles. Away from home for 15 days, the team's longest road trip of the season tests their resilience, chemistry, and commitment, and the Giants say goodbye to a beloved teammate.

videos.title: The Grind
videos.overview: s the trade deadline approaches, the Giants fight to keep their playoff hopes alive. Ryan Lin faces increased pressure at a high-profile showcase, while fan favorite Torretto Marrelli battles for his spot in the lineup. Behind the scenes, Michael Bublé, Drew Scott, and the Giants' leadership team must decide which moves will give the team its best chance to win.

videos.title: Hail Mary
videos.overview: Six points out of a playoff spot, the Vancouver Giants enter the trade deadline determined to find the missing pieces - the skill, chemistry, and experience needed to win. However, this means trading away beloved players, breaking up friendships, and asking the team to come together in a new way.

videos.title: The Final Push
videos.overview: The Vancouver Giants' season reaches its defining moment as playoff hopes hang in the balance. Ryan Lin and Mathis Preston face defining NHL Draft decisions, Torretto Marrelli confronts an uncertain future, and Michael Bublé and Drew Scott rethink the team's next chapter.
